items.title: Momentous 61st Venice Biennale Ends With 2nd-Highest Visitor Turnout
items.summary: Political disputes, a historic strike, and the curator's sudden passing did not keep visitors away.

items.title: Hank Willis Thomas’s Sleight of Hand
items.summary: The artist makes us supremely conscious of being spectators in a society that streams out images faster than factories churn out products.

items.title: For Some Artists, Residency-Hopping Is a Form of Survival
items.summary: Artists are increasingly turning to the programs as sites of refuge as they navigate precarity, commercial pressures, and burnout.

items.title: Something Strange at Maggie Ellis’s Thanksgiving Table
items.summary: In Ellis's world, you can never be quite sure whether you've stumbled into a dream, a nightmare, or someone else's very strange family gathering.
